rationale: The original thesis is mechanically intact — the gap still fully holds with price at 93% of range, pinned a penny under the $31.97 flag-high trigger, above VWAP and the 9-EMA, with no distribution prints and SPY weakness easing (−0.38% vs −0.63% at entry).
